name: event-report
title: Drinking water event report
for_each: select id, code from events order by code

sections.title: The event
sections.sql: select e.code, su.name as supply, su.registration_ref as registration, su.regulator, p.name as point, replace(e.kind, '_', ' ') as kind, e.parameter, e.detected_on, e.description, e.status from events e join supplies su on su.id = e.supply_id left join points p on p.id = e.point_id where e.id = $1

sections.title: What triggered it
sections.sql: select c.sample, c.sampled_on, c.lab, c.point, c.parameter, case when c.qualifier = '=' then '' else c.qualifier end || c.value as result, c.unit, c.verdict from events e join result_check c on c.result_id = e.result_id where e.id = $1

sections.title: Notification and notice
sections.sql: select notified_on as regulator_told_on, notified_by as told_by, regulator_ref as reference, replace(notice, '_', ' ') as notice_to_consumers, notice_on as notice_issued, notice_lifted_on as notice_lifted from events where id = $1

sections.title: Resample
sections.sql: select c.sample, c.sampled_on, c.parameter, case when c.qualifier = '=' then '' else c.qualifier end || c.value as result, c.unit, c.verdict from events e join samples s on s.id = e.resample_id join result_check c on c.sample = s.code where e.id = $1 order by c.parameter

sections.title: Corrective action and close-out
sections.sql: select corrective_action, closed_on, closeout_note from events where id = $1

sections.title: Record of every step
sections.sql: select a.created_at as recorded_at, a.actor as by, a.command as step, a.detail from activity a join events e on e.code = a.record_id where e.id = $1 order by a.id

name: monthly-summary
title: Monthly drinking water summary
for_each: select id, code from supplies where active order by code

sections.title: Supply
sections.sql: select name as supply, operator, registration_ref as registration, regulator, population as people_served, plan_reviewed_on as safety_plan_reviewed from supplies where id = $1

sections.title: Results in the last 30 days
sections.sql: select c.parameter, count(*)::int as results, count(*) filter (where c.verdict = 'ok')::int as within_limits, count(*) filter (where c.verdict in ('over health limit','under health minimum'))::int as health, count(*) filter (where c.verdict like '%operational%')::int as operational, count(*) filter (where c.verdict = 'over aesthetic value')::int as aesthetic from result_check c join supplies su on su.code = c.supply where su.id = $1 and c.sampled_on >= current_date - 30 group by c.parameter order by c.parameter

sections.title: Events
sections.sql: select e.code as event, replace(e.kind, '_', ' ') as kind, e.parameter, e.detected_on, e.notified_on, replace(e.notice, '_', ' ') as notice, e.status from events e where e.supply_id = $1 and (e.status = 'open' or e.detected_on >= current_date - 30) order by e.detected_on

sections.title: Sampling overdue
sections.sql: select d.point, d.parameter, d.every_days, d.last_sampled, d.days_overdue from sampling_due d join supplies su on su.code = d.supply where su.id = $1 and d.days_overdue > 0 order by d.days_overdue desc

sections.title: Safety plan actions open
sections.sql: select code, hazard, action, owner, due from plan_actions where supply_id = $1 and done_on is null order by due
